text: {"820":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"`rustc_middle` defines the compiler's ValTree representation and its type-directed constant semantics."},"821":{"about":["rustc_const_eval"],"refers":[],"why":"CTFE must preserve the invariant that reference pointer identities cannot be observed at compile time."},"822":{"about":["rustc_const_eval","rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"Const evaluation constructs the `rustc_middle` ValTree encoding in which a reference has its referent's value representation."},"823":{"about":["rustc_const_eval"],"refers":[],"why":"Const evaluation performs conversion from ValTrees back into MIR constant values and must reconstruct reference indirection."},"824":{"about":["rustc_codegen_ssa"],"refers":[],"why":"Backend-agnostic code generation governs emission of constants, whose resulting addresses may be merged by optimization."}}
